ruby.line: Heir to the Decisionmaker of Planet Oro, who builds the android Angela.
ruby.short: The heir to the Decisionmaker of Planet Oro. Taught that heirs can have no friends and no feelings, she feels the whole planet is a prison.
ruby.summary: Ruby, heir to the Decisionmaker of Planet Oro, builds the android Angela for the Council and hides a trojan in her as her way out. When the Council turns Angela on Terrinia, Ruby tears out its control unit and falls into a red-eyed rage, which Angela's cry stops short of a child. They escape Oro and become Aspirants at Selrick, and Ruby deletes the trojan when Angela chooses. In the last battle her Oro-built scythe stays lit under Obsidia's field, and when the rage comes back she makes one cut and her eyes stay blue.
rows: Home
Planet Oro, in the galaxy A-20, which she calls a golden birdcage. Later Selrick Academy in Terrinia.
Family
Her father, who leads the Decisionmakers on Oro's Council
Taught by
A tutor in the Council hall, and the Council's engineers, who taught her to program
Secret base
The Gardens on Oro: a stream and white flowers under a roof of glass hexagons
Created
Angela, on a Project Angel body, with a mind Ruby wrote herself and a few locked lines hidden under her walking routines
Closest to
Angela. They promise to wait for each other at the end of the world.
Appearance
Long hair and blue eyes, gloves, shoulder armor and a visor over one eye. In her rage one eye burns red.
Manner
A perfect, polished voice and a face kept blank since she could walk. She still laughs when she thinks nobody is around.
Wants most
To stay in this free land, with Angela
At Selrick
Let in under watch: an AI droid follows her everywhere, and she sits in the third-year class beside Fanny and Layla.
Aspirant
Made one by Lesley, with Angela, in the Academy hall. Her needle passes the line on Chang'e's dial with room to spare.
Battle post
Rear support with Angela: the wounded and the way out, just behind the frontline

weapons.name: Ruby's scythe
weapons.note: A white and orange scythe, taller than she is. Lightning crawls along the blade when she swings, and one swing can cut down a row of androids.

weapons.name: Glove
weapons.note: Her Code Override runs from it: green lines of code that rewrite a machine's orders. On Angela's plate they reach the Council's seal and are denied.

weapons.name: The trojan
weapons.note: A few lines she hid under Angela's walking routines as her way off Oro, with a lock that opens to her hand alone.

weapons.name: The pink doll
weapons.note: A pink doll she hugs as a small child. She makes it bow, low and crooked, the way grown-ups bow to her father. It is put away as she grows.

weapons.name: Slate
weapons.note: A slate she works on in the Gardens, her secret base on Oro.

weapons.name: Shoulder armor
weapons.note: Armor on her shoulders. One of Angela's late blows cracks it, and she steps in again.

weapons.name: Combat suit
weapons.note: The suit she wears at the ceremony where she becomes an Aspirant.

weapons.name: Visor
weapons.note: A visor over one eye. She bends to the screen with it to read the telescope's trace.
